messages:
alex_m: Quick sync — planning to flip the `api_v2_enabled` feature flag in prod for a limited canary next week. Need to confirm owners, SDK redirect behavior, and deprecation window. Who's owning mobile + JS SDK behavior? Also any proxy/router routing rules we need to update? TL;DR: Owners + CRs + milestone dates.
samir: i'm owning server-side routing updates. plan is staged rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~72h. i'll handle header-based routing and fallback policy. need SDK clarity on silent fallbacks.
leah: JS SDK currently falls back to v1 if `X-API-Version` is missing. i'd prefer we avoid silent fallback — better to return explicit error (406) or a clear warning header during the transition window.
chen: mobile SDKs will need a patch. @jordan_mobile you own native libs right? can you confirm ETA and if we need any infra changes?
jordan_mobile: confirmed. i can ship an opt-in patch in 5 business days, stable release in ~2 weeks. i'll add telemetry event `api_version_mismatch` and a toggle for strict mode. need migration guide + sample integration tests.
maya_ops: Ops: we'll open a canary window Mon 09:00 UTC. need rollback playbook + smoke tests. @samir can you add a curl snippet for quick health checks?
samir: here's a smoke test for the new routing:
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'X-API-Version: v2' https://api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{ "prompt":"hello" }'
```
expect 200 and new response schema (tokens, latency_ms).
alex_m: perfect. also want SDKs to emit a deprecation header during warning period: `X-API-Deprecation-When: 2026-04-15` (example). who will own CRs for SDK releases? need reviewers lined up.
leah: i'll review JS PRs and coordinate publish to npm. will add a client console.warn for the warning window.
chen: i'll handle mobile release notes and coordinate with jordan_mobile for App Store / Play timelines.
deploy-bot: Canary flip scheduled: `api_v2_flag` -> true for 5% starting 2026-03-22T09:00Z. Monitor dashboards: /dash/inference/flags. Rollback thresholds set; ops oncall ping if anomalies.
alex_m: status check: owners = leah (JS), jordan_mobile (mobile), samir (routing). action items: owners to create PRs by EOD Thu and add integration tests. if blockers, post here.
jordan_mobile: created WIP PR https://git.internal/r/redwood/mobile-sdk/pulls/421 — includes telemetry + strict-mode toggle. needs 1 reviewer.
leah: opened js PR https://git.internal/r/redwood/js-sdk/pulls/212 — added deprecation header + unit tests. tagging you both. also added an integration test that asserts explicit 406 when strict-mode is on.
maya_ops: ops notes: we'll alert at >1% error rate in canary; auto-roll back at 3% sustained for 15m. i'll paste rollback steps and runbook before flip.
samir: added routing config PR https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/router/pulls/89 — applies header routing and non-silent-fallback policy.
alex_m: thanks all. i'll compile a short checklist for product comms and update the migration board. one ask: please add a test in each SDK asserting no silent fallback when the feature flag is on.
jordan_mobile: will add the test and push within 48h.
alex_m: :thumbsup: marking owners & milestone on the migration board. closing thread unless urgent blockers come up.
